esim-plan-picker/bd-qss3d4yh.note: A Gulf fuel price sign that stacks plan prices fits a picker with a clear price, but the receipt texture is pinned to a total card the picker does not have, and the thermal paper look pulls against the dark lit sign.

esim-plan-picker/bd-ua93rvk5.note: A sliding caliper jaw for choosing GB fits a plan picker and karak tea suits the Gulf market, but the tea glass motion never reaches the mechanic and the amber face is missing from the steel and red palette.

esim-plan-picker/bd-23x2dv09.note: Stepped swatches from light to dark map neatly onto plans that grow in GB and days, and the punch hole on the chosen plan is a fresh, buildable signature, but the rule that every section fills like a progress track only loosely fits a three step picker and pulls against the calm printed swatch card.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-4ol6ei7i.note: A transit line stepper fits a multi-step flight checkout with Arabic type, but it is little more than a standard stepper in magenta, so it will not stop a designer.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-hrud7523.note: Stamp slots filling in as the review, bags and seats, and pay steps finish suit a travel checkout that really has steps, and the ink stamp, ticket mood and restrained palette hang together, though the passport theme is a familiar travel move and the brief does not show how the clear total is handled.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-423nya2k.note: A livery stripe sweeping across a ticket to track the bags, seats and pay steps is a tight, buildable idea, but the red and orange 1970s stripe look comes from American carriers, not Gulf ones, which caps relevance for a GCC brief.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-oo6vqtgg.note: Walnut, brass and cream serif suit a roaster landing page and the amber sugar threads read as caramel, but the flat header ignores the bookmatched hero it promises and drops the cane and plant mood, so the core move feels safe for wildness 4.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-cm7zfgnd.note: A jebena fits a coffee origins landing page, but the texture targets a step header card the page does not have, the woven rattan motion appears nowhere in the layout, button or texture, and a clay pill button is too plain for wildness 4.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-agkaxc64.note: Googie is a natural fit for a coffee shop landing page and the tilted chip nav suits the era, but the Uzbek Rishtan glaze is only loosely tied to 1958 space age styling, and the signature move is modest.

banking-onboarding/bd-79q2txs2.note: Fingerprint suits a bank onboarding identity step, but the Saudi Nafath tie does not fit a global brief, the progress line is a plain bar renamed ridge gray, and the scale move barely reaches the whorl, which sits only on the profile card.

banking-onboarding/bd-9hwrs7gn.note: Punching a hole per finished step keeps the required clear progress on a stepped account opening flow, and the clipped corner, printed column digits, card stock palette and Plex Mono all come from the same IBM card, though the idea stays a fresh skin on one component rather than a rethink of the page.

banking-onboarding/bd-f016xv0s.note: A wax seal to close account opening suits banking trust, but the header mechanic is a plain cream card with no seal, and the idea never ties the seal to the clear progress the brief requires.

fitness-empty-state/bd-qco8tj7z.note: A scout-style sash of blank stitched patch outlines is a specific, buildable empty state for fitness achievements, though the tram control deck image for the bottom rail sits a little apart from the merit badge mood.

fitness-empty-state/bd-vh8k9bbv.note: An Insert Coin attract screen with one start button is a fresh, buildable take on an empty class list, but the Puffer Jacket Nylon twist never reaches the palette, texture or motion and pulls against the arcade look.

fitness-empty-state/bd-14lp4b8c.note: Aicher style pictograms suit a fitness empty state, but the dial texture is never placed in the layout and Inter Tight loses Munich's Univers voice, so the idea stays a familiar pictogram with a faint watch finish.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-uy83sdc9.note: Qamar al-Din is a fitting Ramadan staple for a Gulf offers page, but the glossy liquid, wax and candy mood fights the flat 2013 look, and the cream bar with an amber underline is a plain styling rule rather than a fresh idea.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-ftt9pfi1.note: A bilingual painted souq sign suits a Saudi offers header, but the Tiffin Carrier twist is a South Asian object that never shows up in the mechanic, and nothing here speaks to Ramadan.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-3vdogugw.note: Dotted leaders on a torn thermal receipt card hang together well, but an offers page has no single total, so the mechanic should run leaders from each dish to its old and new price, and nothing about it speaks to Ramadan or the Saudi market beyond the Arabic fonts.

saas-pricing/bd-fluldst5.note: A big condensed price on each plan suits a pricing page and keeps the price clear, and the type, palette and ledger rules hang together, but oversized price numerals are a familiar move, and a 'hero stat card' is an odd fit for a page made of plan cards.

saas-pricing/bd-tdae0ixo.note: A calculator display that shows the computed plan price fits a pricing page and keeps the price clear, and the keycaps, ghost segments, Handjet and orange accent all read as one machine, though plans as keys may squeeze feature comparison.

saas-pricing/bd-gg1xeqc8.note: Dark graphite plan cards with a violet border on the chosen plan fit a B2B pricing page and hang together, but the highlighted plan is the default pricing pattern and adds no fresh idea.

dubai-real-estate/bd-8og4nrhz.note: A ruler band that reads apartment area in meters fits a listing page, and the material swatch blocks could echo real finishes, but the workshop yellow wood grain and mono type feel more like a hardware store than Dubai luxury.

dubai-real-estate/bd-df5nf3f5.note: Coral stone is a true Gulf building material that suits a Dubai luxury listing, but the walnut veneer twist has nothing to do with stone, the texture line calls for flat lime that is not in the palette, and a thin mortar-line divider is too timid for wildness 4.

dubai-real-estate/bd-h0k7z34r.note: Barjeel towers suit a Dubai listing, but the Turkish 1930s era comes from another region and the texture sits on numbered step cards this page does not have, while the plain underlined condensed tabs carry nothing of the wind towers or Ankara and would not stop a designer.

kids-reading-home/bd-f8qpfutx.note: Felt and buttons suit a kids reading tablet home, but a back button on a home screen is odd, the linen weave texture does not come from a sewing button, and a single felt header strip is tame for wildness 5 when felt pieces as book cards would carry the idea further.

kids-reading-home/bd-gfae703r.note: Sticker rewards suit a kids reading home, but the orange accent shape clashes with the pink palette, the office mood is off for kids, and a tilted badge in a dark bar is tame for wildness 5.

kids-reading-home/bd-tzwa21v5.note: Books as game cartridges in a slot on the home shelf is a charming, buildable idea for a kids reading tablet, but the Bubbles twist shrinks to an iridescent ring on one badge and feels tacked on rather than part of the cartridge world, which is tame for wildness 5.

qatar-gov-services/bd-d7dh1vi9.note: Gulf Modernism screen blocks suit a Qatar civic dashboard and the empty state fits a page with no pending fines or renewals, but the grotesk type and plain turquoise tile make the idea quiet, and it barely touches the clear status requirement.

qatar-gov-services/bd-b16tfcdi.note: Staggered manila folder tabs suit a paperwork-heavy government dashboard and the palette, grain and bilingual type all come from the folder, but it is a familiar skeuomorphic move and says little about how clear status is shown.

qatar-gov-services/bd-9lg4mvya.note: Ink filling ruled form boxes as renewal steps complete and a single fingerprint on the ID card suit a Qatar ID dashboard and keep status clear, but the biometric and stamp look is a fairly literal, expected move.
